name: dodo-checkout-monorepo
description: Tiny Embeddable Checkout - Take-home assignment for Dodo Payments

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@dodo/sdk && npm run build --workspace=@dodo/checkout && npm run build --workspace=@dodo/demo
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --workspace=@dodo/sdk && GITHUB_PAGES=true npm run build --workspace=@dodo/checkout && GITHUB_PAGES=true npm run build --workspace=@dodo/demo && mkdir -p apps/demo/dist/checkout && cp -r apps/checkout/dist/* apps/demo/dist/checkout/
